records.text: TPUSA college students and volunteers reported a recurring difficulty moving tickets, including failure to reach capacity for Erika Kirk's Washington event with Karoline Leavitt.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep SubDoZWHARo)

appearances.snippet: Now, I am told by Turning Point USA college students and volunteers that this has been a repeat problem, that they similarly had a very hard time moving tickets for her event in Washington, D.C. with Karoline Leavitt. They just.

verification.notes: Anonymous students and volunteers were the source for the recurring ticketing-difficulty claim. Independent reporting says the Washington event drew about 1,400 and was near capacity, which supports that it did not fully sell out but does not establish recurring difficulty moving tickets.

sources.title: JD Vance: Erika Kirk skips Turning Point event in Georgia after threats
sources.relevance: Reports the Washington event attendance and describes it as near capacity, qualifying the anonymous claim.

records.text: TPUSA students and volunteers reported immediate parental backlash after Erika Kirk was announced for the high-school event.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep SubDoZWHARo)

appearances.snippet: I am told the truth is again that there was immediate parental backlash already that kept happening because she was announced and they basically said, OK, this is an optional event.

verification.notes: The immediate-parental-backlash account is attributed only to unnamed TPUSA students and volunteers. Reporting confirms backlash to a separate later Phoenix school appearance, but not the specific earlier canceled event, so it does not corroborate this claim.
